job: Recover natural opening texture by replacing broadened angular leaves with narrower, more finely segmented deterministic polygons while preserving the proven R03E runtime and schedule.

required: offline angular leaf width returns to the original 1.24 scale
each leaf begins with seven to ten independently seeded diagonal polygon segments
no synchronized tonal bands, periodic barcode pattern or runtime rasterization
R03E worker schedule, placement, binary inventory, draw count and proof remain unchanged
opening and corrected close coverage reach at least 98 percent of pinned baselines
all performance, camera, interaction, flower and settled-demand gates remain green
fresh visual review confirms natural low-poly botanical silhouettes

rejectionGates: baseline, ROI, vegetation classifier, threshold, camera mapping or proof changes
placement, instance inventory, worker schedule, page cap, draw count, alpha mode or runtime construction changes
synchronized tonal bands, barcode texture, neon colour or obvious repeated striping
atlas leaf width differs from 1.24 or the initial polygon segments fall outside the approved seven-to-ten range
opening or corrected close coverage is below 98 percent
camera convergence, flowers, interaction, active render or settled demand gate fails
actual R3F canvas uses software WebGL, full-run render p95 exceeds 16.7 ms or a causal task exceeds 50 ms
repairBoundary: If and only if performance and all non-visual gates pass, adjust the deterministic polygon-segment range by at most two segments at either bound. Width, colour, count, placement, schedule, proof, baseline and threshold remain immutable.

failedEvidence.repairUsed: Increase only the independently seeded polygon-segment range by the permitted two segments at each bound, from seven-to-ten to nine-to-twelve; width, placement, inventory, schedule, proof and thresholds remained unchanged.
failedEvidence.verdict: R03F passes every non-visual gate but remains below the immutable 98 percent opening threshold after its single bounded repair. It is rejected; no further polygon-segment or leaf-width tuning is allowed.
